title: SwiftUI After 7 Years
summary: A critical retrospective examining SwiftUI's evolution and maturity after 7 years, questioning whether Apple's declarative UI framework has lived up to its initial promises or has remained mediocre in its implementation and capabilities.
problem_solved: Provides an honest evaluation of whether SwiftUI successfully simplified cross-platform Apple development or fell short of expectations
why_valuable: Offers a long-term perspective from a practitioner who has used SwiftUI extensively, providing valuable insights for developers deciding on UI framework strategies
